scope: Proposition 11.7 (Conditional working package) of the manuscript “Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes” (preprints/Eventual-Categoricity-for-Abstract-Elementary-Classes-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 240 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dcb7401285f5ac78), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 91. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an admissible shape L. Suppose that GL is categorical at every level in an unbounded class of eligible levels closed sufficiently for the preceding constructions. Assume also the eligible-subclass hypothesis of Convention 5.3. On an unbounded further class of sufficiently closed levels, it satisfies the full working package of Definition 5.2, with its actual system isomorphisms and its arrows from Definition 11.1. The resulting diagrams, saturation, and calculus include mixed arrows between eligible levels, and the output class retains the eligible-subclass hypothesis. The closure requirements are uniform in the finite shape and the fixed pointed template. They use only the smaller and larger input levels specified by the general working-package construction.
